I'll send one `duplicateClipAt` per selected clip in a single `executeAppActionBatch`, so each copy carries exactly what a single duplicate carries, and one undo removes them all. If a redo can't bring back every copy, it's refused whole, like a single duplicate. One choice first, on placement:

A) Each copy goes on its source clip's own track, all shifted by the selection's span (latest end minus earliest start), so the selection repeats as one block right after itself. This is what Cmd+D does in Logic and Ableton.
B) Each copy goes right after its own clip's end, on that clip's track, so clips of different lengths drift apart.

B) Move it immediately and show a toast with Undo.

agent: The reload: lanes live under the checkout's own `.agents/worktrees/` and mirror the repo, so they sit inside the tree Vite watches, and every lane edit reaches the primary checkout's dev server. The fix is `server.watch.ignored`. One choice on how it matches:

A) A glob, `**/.agents/**`. Short, but the watcher matches absolute paths, so a dev server running inside a lane, where every source path contains `/.agents/`, would ignore its own edits and never reload.
B) A function anchored to this checkout's own `.agents` directory: ignore a path only when it is that directory or inside it.

The leftover vite: `scripts/e2eDevServer.ts` spawns vite and doesn't forward Playwright's SIGTERM or Ctrl-C to it. I'll forward both, SIGKILL the child if it hasn't exited 3 s later, log start/cleanup/exit as JSON lines on stderr, and exit with the child's code or re-raise its signal.
